content.prompt: Find the two horizontal lengths, then their difference. Round to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Two right triangles share vertical height 8; near angle 50 degrees and far angle 25 degrees; both right angles at the top left.
spec.mathematics: Use tangent as opposite over adjacent, rearrange horizontal length as height divided by tangent, and subtract the shorter horizontal side from the full side.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and unknown labels appear; answers remain in the solution fields.
